items.source: Creates RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments based on RepositoryMetadata to add MongoDB-specific extensions.
items.translation: 根据 RepositoryMetadata 创建 RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments，以添加 MongoDB 特定的扩展功能。

items.source: Implementations must define a no-args constructor.
items.translation: 实现必须定义一个无参构造函数。

items.source: Returns a composed MongoRepositoryFragmentsContributor that first applies this contributor to its inputs, and then applies the after contributor concatenating effectively both results.
items.translation: 返回一个组合后的 MongoRepositoryFragmentsContributor，它首先将此贡献者应用于其输入，然后应用 after 贡献者，有效地将两者结果拼接在一起。

items.source: Returns a composed MongoRepositoryFragmentsContributor that first applies this contributor to its inputs, and then applies the after contributor concatenating effectively both results. If evaluation of either contributors throws an exception, it is relayed to the caller of the composed contributor.
items.translation: 返回一个组合的 MongoRepositoryFragmentsContributor，该贡献者首先将此贡献者应用于其输入，然后应用 after 贡献者并有效地将两个结果连接起来。如果任一贡献者的评估抛出异常，则该异常会传递给组合贡献者的调用者。

items.source: RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments to be added to the repository.
items.translation: RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments 将被添加到仓库中。

items.source: after - the contributor to apply after this contributor is applied.
items.translation: after - 在此贡献者应用之后应用的贡献者。

items.source: a composed contributor that first applies this contributor and then applies the after contributor.
items.translation: 一个组合的贡献者，它首先应用此贡献者，然后应用 `after` 贡献者。

items.source: MongoDB-specific RepositoryFragmentsContributor contributing fragments based on the repository.
items.translation: 针对存储库贡献 MongoDB 特定的RepositoryFragmentsContributor片段。
